title: AppleNotestoX
description: Local-first macOS pipeline that turns Apple Notes into a durable, reviewable knowledge wiki.
highlights: Built macOS app that exports notes between Apple Notes, Markdown and Notion and tags each export with the original note's unique ID and date
Bundled study tool with SM-2 spaced-repetition flashcards, Apple Speech on-device video transcription and a Groq/Llama assistant that groups related notes and merges or flags duplicates

title: X Bookmark Injector
description: A Chromium extension that resurfaces a random saved X bookmark at the top of your For You feed.
highlights: Built Chromium extension to randomly pull a saved X bookmark at the top of For You with Keep, Done and background auto-sync
Retrieved bookmarks through X's internal GraphQL API from the page by reusing the logged-in session via a service worker that paginates, schema-validates and caches them in chrome.storage
